capabilities: Send the open note and its Vault images to a Tomos site over HTTPS
Create a new note pre-filled with Tomos Front Matter as a starting template
Send draft:true notes to Tomos Inbox for preview before manual publishing
Publish to a GitHub-based Tomos site via the Tomos GitHub App
Report Tomos publish and Bluesky announcement results as Obsidian notices
extras: README is bilingual (Japanese and English). Image transfer is limited to JPEG, PNG, GIF and WebP, up to 5 images per article and 10MB each; SVG is not supported. Images are resized to a 2048px long edge for GitHub publishing. The plugin never modifies the original note or moves Vault images.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send a note together with its local embedded images straight to a Tomos site for preview and publishing.

relations.evidence: Tomos Publisher sends Markdown and local images from Desktop and Mobile to a Tomos site over HTTPS.
To publish to a GitHub-based Tomos site, choose GitHub版Tomos as the destination, connect through the Tomos GitHub App
